calls.statement:
WITH sales AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year fy, s.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) gross_all, sum(CASE WHEN NOT f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount END) ex_staff, count(DISTINCT f.sale_date) days_sold,
         count(*) - count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) dup_lines
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  WHERE d.fiscal_period=1 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND s.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2),
rets AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year fy, s.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) ret_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
  WHERE d.fiscal_period=1 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND s.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2),
rpt AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year fy, r.store_id, sum(r.net_sales_before_returns) nsbr, sum(r.returns_net) rn, sum(r.net_sales) ns
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period=1 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT s.fy, s.store_id, s.gross_all, s.ex_staff, s.days_sold, s.dup_lines, r.ret_net, p.nsbr, p.rn, p.ns
FROM sales s LEFT JOIN rets r USING(fy, store_id) LEFT JOIN rpt p USING(fy, store_id) ORDER BY store_id, fy

WITH per_store AS (
  SELECT business_date, store_id, net_sales FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id < 900
),
period AS (
  SELECT p.store_id, d.fiscal_year, sum(p.net_sales) net_sales, sum(p.net_sales) FILTER (WHERE d.is_trading_day) trading_sales
  FROM per_store p JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = p.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 1 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
wide AS (
  SELECT store_id, max(net_sales) FILTER (WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26') ly, max(net_sales) FILTER (WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27') ty
  FROM period GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 'lfl_main' v, count(*) n_stores, sum(ly) ly, sum(ty) ty, round((sum(ty)/sum(ly)-1)*100,2) growth_pct
FROM wide WHERE ly IS NOT NULL AND ty IS NOT NULL AND store_id NOT IN (136,137)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'incl_136_137', count(*), sum(ly), sum(ty), round((sum(ty)/sum(ly)-1)*100,2) FROM wide WHERE ly IS NOT NULL AND ty IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'per_trading_day_adj', count(*), sum(ly)/27, sum(ty)/28, round(((sum(ty)/28)/(sum(ly)/27)-1)*100,2) FROM wide WHERE ly IS NOT NULL AND ty IS NOT NULL AND store_id NOT IN (136,137)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'all_stores_total_not_lfl', count(*), sum(coalesce(ly,0)), sum(coalesce(ty,0)), round((sum(ty)/sum(ly)-1)*100,2) FROM wide
